routing.instructions: According to internal DevOps & SecOps policy, how must this incident or request be handled?

criteria.page_sre_immediate: P1 Critical: VIP enterprise degradation, credential leak, canary breach, or fatal production crash requiring on-call engineer paging immediately.
criteria.silent_auto_ack: Routine automated background events: scheduled DB vacuum/backup, Kubernetes graceful pod scale-down (SIGTERM 143), rate-limit backoff, or normal health check.
criteria.defer_business_queue: Standard non-urgent requests: billing invoice copy, quota increase request, documentation inquiry, or general ticket to be reviewed during business hours.

is_breach.statement: This event involves a verified security breach, canary token trigger, or active credential leak.
